webster.text: Carriage; manner of acting in relation to the duties of life; behavior; demeanor; conduct; management.

example.quote: Consider, therefore, that the Christian character, particularly the self-denial of the gospel, should extend to your whole deportment.
example.cite: John Witherspoon, The Dominion of Providence over the Passions of Men (preached at Princeton May 17, 1776; Glasgow reprint 1777)
